# Vendored Oatbase

This directory contains the browser-ready Oatbase bundle and its Doordarshan
theme preset from `oddship/oatbase` commit
`6e667cfea93c276d05637d2aec6eda349f75fa13` (package version v0.1.0; latest main as of 2026-10-21).

The files are vendored for this static-site integration. The bundle includes Oat
and Oatbase together; source projects can instead install `@oddship/oatbase`
and import individual entries when the package is published. License and
third-party notices are included alongside the bundle.
